prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit with immutable canonical identities. First images are canonical portraits, next is the engineering ROOM reference, LAST exact target. Preserve exact facial morphology, eyes, noses, jaws, adult ages, expressions, hairstyles, skin, body poses and continuous two-arm chains, natural grips and furniture contact. Preserve cinematic adventure-comic staging and room geometry. Farah lens anatomical LEFT eye; Demir comms anatomical RIGHT ear. Keep natural short necks. Every unspecified rear, side and wrist screen is inactive charcoal glass, no decorative graphs or fake code. Retain physical buttons. Muted sage interfaces and aged brass, no neon mint, fluorescent lime or broad mustard wash. Warm engineering lamps remain local. Keep both full head sizes and faces exactly unchanged. Use existing three connected tabletop modules as a concrete blend demonstration. The three module displays, top to bottom: "LSTM 0.045" with smaller "weight 0.333"; "Attention 0.038" with "weight 0.467"; "Kalman 0.058" with "weight 0.200". Left input display reads "Prior-period MAE" and "Normalized errors". Right combined output display reads "Weighted blend" and "Evaluate later". Farah held translucent card shows only "Rounded shares" and "Sum = 1". Replace all waveforms. Keep connections between all three modules and one output, but desaturate them to muted sage thin light without bloom. These are prior-period errors and rounded shares, no claim of probability or improved result. Every background and wrist screen OFF. Clean bold linework, flat cel shading, slight adult stylization, cinematic character framing. Output one full 1536x1024 scene only.
